evidence.summary: Source expresses bounded admission, lifecycle, pending cancellation, deterministic merge, and failure distinction.
TaskScope executes artifact calls on bounded host threads with deterministic merge and joined lifetime.
Running provider effects still lack an interruptible generic handle.
